decisions.reason: As a young product with no sign of poor market acceptance, good fit with the firm's move to combine traditional woodcraft with technology, and likely support from a broad established portfolio, management would more likely retain it while learning about demand.

Because it builds directly on the firm's established seasonal wooden décor business and there is no evidence of underperformance, it is likely to meet or stay close enough to aspiration levels to remain in the range.

Its close relation to the firm's core handcrafted incense-smoker style products and its fit with a more contemporary design direction make continued offering more likely than withdrawal absent clear disappointing results.
